      Abstract
Graphs are very important parts of Big Data and widely used for modelling complex structured
data with a broad spectrum of applications such as bioinformatics, web search, social network,
road network, etc. Over the last decade, tremendous research efforts have been devoted to many
fundamental problems in managing and analysing graph data. In this talk, I will present some
of our recent research efforts in processing big graphs including scalable processing theory and
techniques, distributed computation, and system framework.
